name: Natural Stone Shoulder
description: A traditional strength feat where an irregularly shaped natural rock is lifted from the ground and placed on one shoulder. The unpredictable shape demands adaptive grip and body position. This develops the same hip drive and upper body power as atlas stone training but with a unique challenge.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Natural Stone Shoulder in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Natural Stone Shoulder.
steps: Step 1: Position over natural stone finding best grip on irregular surface.
Step 2: Pull stone up to lap position using deadlift pattern.
Step 3: Continue lifting stone up torso toward shoulder level.
Step 4: Load stone onto shoulder and stand fully upright.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Find the best grip given the rock's shape
Legs and hips do the heavy work
